mappings.actualSourceContext: Klasse9/A1 Wasser als Lösemittel, concrete mandatory left-column preparation objective; no official GK/LK course duty.
mappings.operatorSpecificRationaleDe: Aktuelles ganzes135-P verlangt persönliche Freigabe-/Stoffprüfung, getrenntes Tarieren/Abwiegen von48,0gWasser und2,0gSalz, vollständiges Übertragen, Rühren bis zur beobachteten homogenen Lösung, Beschriftung und eigenes Aktions-/Ergebnisprotokoll. Das trägt den realen Herstellungs-/Handhabungs-/Dokumentationsanteil des ganzen Klasse9-Operators, nicht dessen quantitative Konzentrationsfestlegung.
mappings.operatorSpecificRationaleEn: The whole current135 P requires personal permission/material checks, separate taring/weighing of48.0g water and2.0g salt, complete transfer, stirring to an observed homogeneous solution, labelling and an own action/result record. This contributes real preparation/handling/documentation within the whole Grade9 operator, not its quantitative concentration specification.
mappings.actualExistingFreshTransfer: Native fresh L/S/G modules require own authorized substance/solvent/action record; no final-volume measurement is silently added.
mappings.individualUncoveredSourceDuty: Only actual personally supervised real preparation counts for the SL manufacturing operator. Neither model/reference values nor permitted simulator actions in other own-P routes prove real preparation. The whole source demands a defined mass concentration; the current48+2g route has no final solution volume, so it establishes no gamma. All original L/S/G fresh modules, solvent permissions and country-specific extra routes remain intact; no whole source or new P approval.

mappings.wholeOriginalPrimaryOperator: bewerten unter dem Aspekt der Nachhaltigkeit das Verbot bestimmter halogenierter Alkane.
mappings.actualSourceContext: EP naturwissenschaftlicher Zweig/C1, mandatory complete left-column ban-evaluation operator; not a universal GK/LK final standard.
mappings.operatorSpecificRationaleDe: Ganzes aktuelles3c9-C/P verbindet eigenen echten Such-/Öffnen-/Lese-/Zitatnachweis mit FCKW-12-Nutzen und getrennten Umwelt-/UV-/direkten Expositionspfaden sowie Handlungsabwägung. Der frische HFKW-134a-Fall trennt Ozon-, Klima- und lokale Expositionswirkungen und widerlegt „ozonfreundlich=umweltneutral“. Das liefert chemische Nachhaltigkeitsargumente als Teilgrundlage für die Bewertung eines Verbots bestimmter Halogenalkane.
mappings.operatorSpecificRationaleEn: The whole current3c9 C/P links an actual own search/open/read/quote record with CFC-12 utility, separate environment/UV/direct exposure pathways and weighing options. The fresh HFC-134a case distinguishes ozone, climate and local exposure effects and rejects ozone-friendly=environmentally neutral. This provides chemical sustainability arguments as a partial foundation for evaluating a ban on specified halogenated alkanes.
mappings.actualExistingFreshTransfer: Actual independent complementary HFC-134a source/quote, no ozone-to-climate shortcut, substance-specific benefit/exposure and bounded recovery recommendation; not a new legal judgment.
mappings.individualUncoveredSourceDuty: The whole SL operator remains evaluation of a ban on specified halogenated alkanes in EP C1, separately in NW and language branches. Current3c9 supplies the chemical benefit/impact/criterion argument component only: it does not presently demand an explicit documented ban judgment or prove current law, legal validity, actual group debate or real substance handling. The ban-evaluation remainder stays open. The current own search/citation route is a condition on learner performance, not a completed research artifact.
